tests.given: Eligible E1 and no class; same create command K on two connections.
tests.interleaving: A begins and pauses before commit; B sends K; release A, then B.
tests.expected: Exactly one class and educator membership; same class identity; no duplicate audit intent.

tests.given: One issued token; eligible A and B with distinct commands.
tests.interleaving: A locks class/invite; B waits; commit A; resume B.
tests.expected: Only A redeems; B receives generic unavailable; no B membership or account enumeration.

tests.given: Issued token and policy denied for A.
tests.interleaving: Inject failure after eligibility check and before membership insert; retry with unchanged denied policy.
tests.expected: Token remains unused; no membership/redemption/receipt committed.

tests.given: Token issued; A joining while educator revokes token.
tests.interleaving: Run revoke-first and join-first schedules with class lock barriers.
tests.expected: Revoke-first denies join; join-first records membership, revoke cannot silently remove it.

tests.given: A active in C1 with accepted assignment and report ready.
tests.interleaving: Commit membership revocation first; release waiting submit.
tests.expected: Submit denied; no report/receipt inserted and no private Task changed.

tests.given: A active; submit obtains required locks first.
tests.interleaving: Submit commits; revoke then commits; replay submit/read afterward.
tests.expected: Receipt remains restricted; later ordinary teacher access denied; no stale cached content returned.

tests.given: X current version 1; two authorized edits from E1.
tests.interleaving: Send both with expectedVersion 1 using separate connections.
tests.expected: One new revision/version only; loser receives conflict with no private-schedule change.

tests.given: A has no acceptance for X and both devices confirm same revision.
tests.interleaving: Use different command IDs concurrently; force each to attempt create.
tests.expected: One private Task/link; both authorized results reference same identity; no teacher acceptance metric.

tests.given: Valid first assignment acceptance.
tests.interleaving: Inject rollback separately after Task, link, and private receipt insert before commit.
tests.expected: All three effects absent after each rollback; source assignment unchanged; retry can commit once.

tests.given: Acceptance commits but mobile receives timeout and restarts.
tests.interleaving: Before revocation, reuse that command ID to accept another assignment; then revoke membership and recover the original receipt.
tests.expected: Cross-assignment command reuse conflicts with no second receipt; owner A recovers only the original private pointer; B denied; no new Task or class content.

tests.given: A accepted X; private task T later deleted.
tests.interleaving: Retry original accept and a fresh accept command; recover private receipt.
tests.expected: Return permitted deleted-link state without recreating T; no bypass via fresh command ID.

tests.given: Report r1; A prepares two different progress amendments.
tests.interleaving: Run both expectedVersion 1 concurrently and replay one ID with changed content.
tests.expected: Exactly one next revision; stale amendment and altered-command replay conflict; no silent overwrite.

tests.given: A shared report; E1 preparing feedback.
tests.interleaving: Run withdrawal-first and feedback-first using lock barriers.
tests.expected: Withdrawal-first prevents feedback; feedback-first may commit but becomes inaccessible after withdrawal.

tests.given: Report withdrawn at r2, queued old submit still exists.
tests.interleaving: Replay old command; then send freshly confirmed r2 re-share.
tests.expected: Old replay cannot expose selection; new valid share r3 contains only new selection, no restored feedback.

tests.given: Report r1 changed to r2 before E1 feedback commit.
tests.interleaving: Try feedback for r1; then authorized current-revision correction.
tests.expected: Stale target conflicts; feedback never silently retargets or modifies private Task.

tests.given: Class C1 active with accepted private Tasks.
tests.interleaving: Race archive against invite/publish/submit; then try leave/withdraw.
tests.expected: No new work after archive wins; leave/withdraw still work; private Tasks unaffected.

tests.given: E1/C1, E2/C2, A/B membership fixtures and foreign IDs.
tests.interleaving: Read through API, direct grants, views and callable functions; forge class/assignment/submission links.
tests.expected: No foreign row/content/existence leak; learner view contains only own report; no private Task joins.

tests.given: Invite issued, successful response lost, encrypted delivery copy retained.
tests.interleaving: Replay same issue command; then consume/expire/revoke and replay again.
tests.expected: Same token only while issued/authorized; closed response has null token; no plaintext log/receipt copy.

tests.given: Expired auth/changed policy and command already stored.
tests.interleaving: Replay using another account, stale policy, or archived class.
tests.expected: Recheck current authority before result projection; no old access through idempotency cache.

tests.given: Membership list spans pages; member revoked between reads.
tests.interleaving: Reuse cursor under different actor/class/filter and continue after revocation.
tests.expected: Cursor bound to authorized scope; mismatch denied and current access rechecked on every page.

tests.given: Withdraw/leave/account deletion tombstones and isolated backup fixture.
tests.interleaving: Restore disposable backup then apply reviewed privacy recovery before enabling access.
tests.expected: No withdrawn data/access resurrected; required account/class-family export exclusions explicit.

tests.given: Same private Task later edited while client accepts/replays receipt.
tests.interleaving: Crash after server commit; merge into mobile after a newer Task version exists.
tests.expected: Never overwrite newer local/private work with old snapshot; pointer recovery then ordinary versioned sync.

tests.given: Concurrent invite issue/join and account policy revocation; cross-class commands.
tests.interleaving: Force both lock acquisition orders and a database deadlock/serialization abort.
tests.expected: No unsafe commit; bounded retry of full same intent with fresh authorization; no network calls under locks.

tests.given: Shared progress contains only permitted categorical value.
tests.interleaving: Inject private Task fields into requests and synthetic dirty response projections; inspect receipts/logs/export.
tests.expected: Strict shape rejection/redaction; no schedule/notes/files/focus history/XP or private acceptance evidence exposed.
